# Terse

> Terse is an on-device AI agent butler for macOS and Windows that cuts AI token costs by 40-70%. It compresses prompts before they hit the API, live-monitors 8 coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot CLI, Cline, Windsurf, OpenClaw, Aider), enforces spending limits with a budget circuit breaker that can pause or kill a runaway agent before its next API call, manages MCP servers with security risk scoring, and diagnoses token waste with Terse Doctor. It runs 100% on-device — prompts never leave your machine. Also available as a Chrome extension and a VS Code extension.

## Key Facts
- Reduces token usage 40-70% on verbose prompts; 35+ on-device optimization techniques (<5ms)
- Live monitoring of 8 agents: input/output tokens, cache read/write efficiency, per-turn cost (model-aware pricing), burn rate, context-window fill
- Budget circuit breaker: burn-rate / token / dollar ceilings that escalate from alert to pausing (SIGSTOP) or killing (SIGTERM) the agent process before the next API call
- MCP Manager: discovers every MCP server across Claude Code / Cursor / Windsurf configs; risk-scores each (remote transport, embedded credentials, code-execution surface, unpinned supply chain); enable/disable without editing JSON
- Terse Doctor: ~25 consent-gated scans — cache thrash, duplicate tool calls, redundant file reads, context burn, CLAUDE.md token tax, secret exposure, runaway runtimes — with one-click fixes
- 3 optimization modes: Soft (typo-fix only), Normal (filler removal), Aggressive (max compression); code blocks always protected
- Alert Center: macOS/Windows notifications, Slack webhook, ntfy.sh push; weekly savings digest
- Team sharing: publish live agent sessions and aggregate stats to teammates
- Pricing: Free 30-day trial; Monthly $4.99/mo; macOS + Windows, built with Tauri + Rust + Swift
